introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our platform and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.intro: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you:

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.intro: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:

purposes.processOrders: To process and deliver your orders
purposes.manageAccount: To manage your account and provide customer support
purposes.sendInfo: To send you important information regarding your purchases
purposes.improve: To improve our platform and services
purposes.marketing: To send you marketing communications (with your consent)

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.paragraph1: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. We limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know.
dataSecurity.paragraph2: All payment transactions are encrypted using SSL technology. We do not store complete payment card details on our servers.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We will only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.

yourRights.title: Your Legal Rights
yourRights.intro: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data:

rights.access: Request access to your personal data
rights.correction: Request correction of your personal data
rights.erasure: Request erasure of your personal data
rights.object: Object to processing of your personal data
rights.restriction: Request restriction of processing your personal data
rights.transfer: Request transfer of your personal data

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our platform uses cookies to distinguish you from other users. This helps us to provide you with a good experience when you browse our platform and also allows us to improve our site. A cookie is a small file of letters and numbers that we store on your browser or the hard drive of your computer.

thirdPartyLinks.title: Third-Party Links
thirdPartyLinks.content: Our platform may include links to third-party websites, plug-ins and applications. Clicking on those links or enabling those connections may allow third parties to collect or share data about you. We do not control these third-party websites and are not responsible for their privacy statements.

childrenPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our Service is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this Privacy Policy.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us through our Contact page.

acceptance.content: By accessing and using this e-commerce platform ("Service"), you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

useLicense.title: Use License
useLicense.intro: Permission is granted to temporarily access the materials (information or software) on our platform for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing only. This is the grant of a license, not a transfer of title, and under this license you may not:

accountTerms.title: Account Terms
accountTerms.security: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password. We cannot and will not be liable for any loss or damage from your failure to comply with this security obligation.
accountTerms.responsibility: You are responsible for all content posted and activity that occurs under your account.

productInfo.title: Product Information
productInfo.content: We strive to provide accurate product descriptions and pricing. However, we do not warrant that product descriptions, pricing, or other content is accurate, complete, reliable, current, or error-free. If a product offered by us is not as described, your sole remedy is to return it in unused condition.

pricing.title: Pricing and Payment
pricing.changes: All prices are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue products without notice. We shall not be liable to you or any third party for any modification, price change, suspension, or discontinuance of any product.
pricing.payment: Payment must be received by us before your order is dispatched. We accept various payment methods as indicated during checkout.

shipping.title: Shipping and Delivery
shipping.content: We will arrange for shipment of ordered products to you. Please check the individual product page for specific delivery options. Title and risk of loss pass to you upon our delivery to the carrier. Shipping and handling charges are non-refundable.

returns.title: Returns and Refunds
returns.content: Please review our Returns Policy for detailed information about returns and refunds. In general, items may be returned within 30 days of receipt in their original condition.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: In no event shall our company or its suppliers be liable for any damages (including, without limitation, damages for loss of data or profit, or due to business interruption) arising out of the use or inability to use the materials on our platform.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Your use of our Service is also governed by our Privacy Policy. Please review our Privacy Policy, which also governs the Service and informs users of our data collection practices.

modifications.title: Modifications to Terms
modifications.content: We reserve the right to revise these terms of service at any time without notice. By using this Service you are agreeing to be bound by the then current version of these terms of service.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws and you irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in that location.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us through our Contact page.

help.title: Help Center
help.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions below. If you need additional assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team.

trackOrder.title: Track Your Order
trackOrder.description: Check the status of your order in real-time

returnsRefunds.title: Returns & Refunds
returnsRefunds.description: Learn about our return policy and process

contactSupport.title: Contact Support
contactSupport.description: Get in touch with our support team

stillNeedHelp.title: Still Need Help?
stillNeedHelp.description: If you couldn't find the answer you're looking for, our customer support team is ready to assist you. Contact us via email, phone, or our contact form.

placeOrder.question: How do I place an order?
placeOrder.answer: Browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll need to create an account or log in to complete your purchase.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and other secure payment methods.

trackOrder.question: How can I track my order?
trackOrder.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also view your order status in the "My Orders" section of your account.

returnPolicy.question: What is your return policy?
returnPolicy.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Products must be unused and in original packaging. See our Returns page for full details.

shippingTime.question: How long does shipping take?
shippingTime.answer: Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping options are available at checkout for faster delivery.

international.question: Do you ship internationally?
international.answer: Yes, we ship to many countries worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by location. International orders may be subject to customs fees.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer: Click on "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email address and we'll send you instructions to reset your password.

cancelOrder.question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
cancelOrder.answer: Orders can be cancelled or modified within 1 hour of placement. After that, please contact customer support for assistance.

paymentSecurity.question: Are my payment details secure?
paymentSecurity.answer: Yes, we use industry-standard SSL encryption to protect your payment information. We never store your full credit card details on our servers.

contactSupport.question: How do I contact customer support?
contactSupport.answer: You can reach us via email at {{supportEmail}}, by phone at {{supportPhone}}, or through our Contact page.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.satisfactionAlert: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you're not happy with your order, we're here to help.

returnPolicy.title: Return Policy
returnPolicy.intro: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. To be eligible for a return, your item must be:

conditions.unused: Unused and in the same condition that you received it
conditions.receipt: Accompanied by the receipt or proof of purchase

nonReturnableItems.title: Non-Returnable Items
nonReturnableItems.intro: Certain items cannot be returned, including:

steps.step1: Log in to your account and go to "My Orders"
steps.step2: Select the order containing the item you wish to return
steps.step3: Click "Request Return" and follow the instructions
steps.step4: Pack the item securely in its original packaging
steps.step5: Ship the item to the address provided in your return confirmation

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.inspection: Once we receive your return, we will inspect the item and notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
refunds.processing: If approved, your refund will be processed and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment within 5-10 business days.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.policy: We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange an item for the same product, please contact us at {{supportEmail}}.

shippingCosts.title: Shipping Costs
shippingCosts.customerResponsibility: You will be responsible for paying your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.
shippingCosts.defectiveCoverage: If the item was defective or damaged upon arrival, we will cover the return shipping costs.

needHelp.title: Need Help?
needHelp.message: If you have any questions about our return policy, please contact our customer support team at {{supportEmail}} or call {{supportPhone}}.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.intro: We offer various shipping options to meet your needs. All orders are processed within 1-2 business days (excluding weekends and holidays).

domesticShipping.title: Domestic Shipping (United States)
domesticShipping.freeShippingNote: * Free standard shipping on orders of $50 or more

internationalShipping.title: International Shipping
internationalShipping.customsNote: * International orders may be subject to customs fees and import duties

orderTracking.title: Order Tracking
orderTracking.paragraph1: Once your order has shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can track your package using this number on our website or the carrier's website.
orderTracking.paragraph2: You can also view your order status anytime by logging into your account and visiting the "My Orders" section.

restrictions.title: Shipping Restrictions
restrictions.paragraph1: We currently ship to most countries worldwide. However, some items may have shipping restrictions due to size, weight, or local regulations. These restrictions will be noted on the product page.
restrictions.paragraph2: We do not ship to P.O. boxes for certain items. Please provide a physical address for delivery when possible.

damagedOrLost.title: Damaged or Lost Packages
damagedOrLost.paragraph: If your package arrives damaged or goes missing during transit, please contact us immediately at {{supportEmail}}. We will work with the carrier to resolve the issue and ensure you receive your order.

questionsAboutShipping.title: Questions About Shipping?
questionsAboutShipping.paragraph: If you have any questions about shipping or need assistance with your order, please contact our customer support team at {{supportEmail}} or call {{supportPhone}}.
